links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading grade level of AI responses versus web-based patient resources
links.effect: AI responses written at lower grade level (7.6 ± 2.4) than web-based excerpts (11.1 ± 5.2; P = 0.042), without impacting content quality.
links.quote: Without impacting content quality, AI responses were written at a lower grade level (7.6 ± 2.4) than web-based excerpts (11.1 ± 5.2; P = 0.042).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy, readability, and patient-centeredness of generative LLM responses (ChatGPT and Gemini) to common patient questions regarding heavy menstrual bleeding compared to web-based patient education resources.
